title: I Can Go Out With My Friends Again (And I'm Not Going Back to Cigarettes)
excerpt: I gave up my social life for almost two years to stay away from smoking triggers. Then I found Piantasia — and got it all back.

children.text: For almost two years, I had a rule: no bars, no nights out, no parties where people smoke.

It sounds extreme. But if you've ever tried to stay off cigarettes, you know exactly what I mean. The moment someone lights up next to you, every bit of resolve you've built over months disappears in about three seconds. One cigarette becomes five. Five becomes a pack. And the next morning you wake up hating yourself, back at square one.
So I made a deal with myself. I chose my lungs over my social life. And for a while, it worked.
But it was lonely.
The Real Cost of Quitting Smoking Nobody Talks About
Everyone celebrates the health wins when you quit — and they're real. But there's a side of quitting that doesn't make it into the motivational posts:
you lose a huge part of your social ritual.
Smoking is woven into how people connect. The cigarette break at a party. Standing outside a bar at midnight talking about everything and nothing. That moment where someone asks
"do you smoke?"
and suddenly you're in a conversation.
When you quit, you don't just lose the cigarette — you lose the social cue that came with it. I didn't know how to stand outside a bar with my hands empty. I felt like a stranger at my own table.
So I stopped going out. It was easier.
How I Found Piantasia

A friend of mine — the same one who later co-founded Piantasia — kept telling me about herbal blends. Tobacco-free, nicotine-free, but actually smokeable. I was skeptical. I'd tried herbal cigarettes before and they tasted like burning grass clippings.

But she showed me what she was working on with Piantasia. Actual thought had gone into it — real herbs, real flavour, real ritual. It wasn't a nicotine replacement. It was a smoking experience without the part that was destroying me.
The first time I tried it I was surprised. It felt
right
. Not like a sad substitute. Like something I could actually enjoy.
The Night I Tested It
There was a birthday party coming up — a close friend, people I genuinely missed. I decided to go, and I brought Piantasia with me.
I won't lie, I was nervous. The first time someone lit a cigarette near me I felt that familiar pull. But I had something in my pocket. I stepped outside, lit a Piantasia, and joined the group.
And that was it. I stood there, talked, laughed, felt part of things again — without the craving spiralling out of control. I smoked one. Then a bit later, another. That was all I needed.
I didn't touch a cigarette that night. Or the next one. Or the one after that.
Why It Works (For Me)
I'm not a doctor and I won't tell you what to do with your body. But here's what I think was happening:
The trigger was never really about nicotine.
It was about the act — the break from the room, the ritual of lighting something, the feeling of belonging to the group outside. Piantasia gave me all of that without the addiction hook.

One or two Piantasia in a social setting is nothing like chain-smoking a packet of cigarettes. The urge that used to feel completely out of control simply... didn't escalate. It had somewhere to go and it stayed there.
I'm Going Out Again
That might sound like a small thing. It isn't.
I went to four events last month. A birthday, a work dinner with drinks after, a Sunday afternoon in a beer garden, a late night with old friends I hadn't seen in years. I was
present
for all of them — not watching the clock waiting to leave, not white-knuckling it in the corner.
Quitting smoking cost me two years of going out. Piantasia gave me back my social life.

If you're in the same position I was — hiding from situations that trigger you, missing people because the risk feels too high — it might be worth trying. Not as a cure, not as a medical solution, just as a ritual that fits where the old one used to be.
You deserve to be in the room.

title: How to Use Herbal Blends: Five Ways to Make Piantasia Part of Your Ritual
seoTitle: How to Use Herbal Blends: 5 Ways and What's Inside | Piantasia
metaDescription: Five ways to use a tobacco-free, nicotine-free herbal blend: on its own, with tobacco, as a base, in a vaporizer or a shisha. Plus the herbs inside each blend.
excerpt: There is no single right way to use a herbal blend. Here is how our customers do it.

children.text: A herbal blend is a mix of dried plants with no tobacco and no nicotine. Some people roll it on its own. Some mix it with tobacco. Some use it as a base for other herbs.
Here are the five ways we see most.
1. On its own
The simplest way: roll it like tobacco. Our blends are lightly milled for a soft, workable texture.
Blend 01 is fresh and minty, made for daytime. Blend 02 is soft and floral, made for the evening. Blend 03 is clean and neutral.
2. Mixed with tobacco
Mixing a blend with your tobacco means less tobacco in every cigarette: less nicotine, fewer additives.
It also changes the taste. Blend 01 gives a fresh, minty note. Blend 02 a softer, floral one. Some people use it to cut down step by step, instead of quitting overnight.
3. As a base for other herbs
Blend 03 is designed as a neutral base. It carries the character of whatever you mix it with, without adding nicotine. If you usually mix your herbs with tobacco, it is a nicotine-free alternative.
4. In a vaporizer
The herbs can also go in a dry herb vaporizer, for those who prefer not to burn them.
5. In a shisha
The blends can also be used in a shisha, as a tobacco-free option.
What's in our blends
Every Piantasia blend is made from certified organic herbs from Italy and Germany. No tobacco, no nicotine, no additives. These are the plants you'll find inside, and what each one brings.
Mullein:
a soft, fuzzy leaf with a mild taste. The classic base of herbal blends, for an even burn. In Blend 01 and 03.
Marshmallow leaf:
a soft texture that helps the blend hold together and feel smooth. In all three blends.
Raspberry leaf:
light and leafy, with a subtle sweetness. In all three blends.
Peppermint:
fresh and cooling. In Blend 01.
Lemon balm:
bright, lemony and green. In Blend 01 and 03.
Damiana:
warm and gently aromatic. In Blend 01 and 02.
Lavender:
floral and calm. In Blend 02.
Chamomile:
soft and rounded, with a light floral sweetness. In Blend 02.
Passionflower:
mild and green. In Blend 02 and 03.
Linden flower:
delicate and softly floral. In Blend 03.
In short: Blend 01 is built around peppermint, Blend 02 around raspberry leaf and florals, and Blend 03 around soft, neutral leaves.
Three people, three rituals

Francesco stayed away from bars and parties for almost two years, so he wouldn't be pulled back into smoking. With Piantasia in his pocket he started going out again: one or two at a party, instead of a pack.
Read his story →

Fabienne decided to quit at a yoga retreat. On the first evening, Blend 02 took the place of her cigarette before bed. Today she has left her ten cigarettes a day behind, and Blend 02 is still her evening ritual.
Read her story →

Julian smokes now and then: with friends, on stressful days, in the evening with his own herbs. He wanted something more intentional, without nicotine or additives. The fresh, minty taste of Blend 01 became part of his evening ritual.
Read his story →

title: L'ultima sigaretta di Fabienne (e il rituale che ne ha preso il posto)
seoTitle: Miscela di erbe senza tabacco: la storia di Fabienne | Piantasia
metaDescription: Fabienne aveva deciso di smettere con il tabacco a un ritiro di yoga. La sera, al posto della sigaretta, il Blend 02: una miscela di erbe senza nicotina.
excerpt: Aveva deciso di smettere durante un ritiro di yoga. La prima sera, al posto della sigaretta, è arrivata una Piantasia.

children.text: Ho conosciuto Fabienne a un ritiro di yoga.
Il primo giorno mi ha raccontato che quella mattina aveva fumato la sua ultima sigaretta. Smettere era l'intenzione che si era portata al ritiro.
Ho sorriso tra me e me. Sapevo che sarei stata testimone di tutto quello che viene dopo: i primi giorni senza nicotina, l'astinenza, il corpo che chiede.
La prima sera
Non ho dovuto aspettare molto.

La sera stessa l'ho vista girare tra le persone del ritiro, chiedendo se qualcuno aveva una sigaretta da darle. Dieci sigarette al giorno per anni non si cancellano con un'intenzione scritta la mattina.
Io stavo fumando una Piantasia, il Blend 02. Gliel'ho offerta.
Non era solo la nicotina
Chi ha provato a smettere lo sa. Non ti manca solo la sostanza. Ti manca il gesto: il momento a fine giornata in cui ti fermi, le mani che sanno cosa fare, il respiro lento prima di andare a dormire.
Quel gesto Fabienne poteva tenerlo. Solo senza nicotina.
Il Blend 02
Il Blend 02 è il nostro blend più morbido: foglia di lampone, lavanda, camomilla, passiflora, altea e damiana. Lavanda e camomilla sono piante che da sempre si associano al rilassamento e alla sera.
Da quella sera è diventato il suo momento prima di dormire. Ogni giorno, a fine giornata, si rollava il suo Blend 02.
Da abitudine a rituale
Verso la fine del ritiro mi ha detto una cosa che non ho più dimenticato: stava diventando un rituale.
Non più qualcosa da fare per bisogno, ma un momento da godersi con intenzione. La stava aiutando ad attraversare i giorni più difficili dell'astinenza.
Tornata a casa, ha comprato la sua prima scatola.
Oggi
Fabienne ha chiuso con le sue dieci sigarette al giorno.
Oggi è una fumatrice occasionale. Ogni tanto si concede una sigaretta, senza ricadere nell'abitudine quotidiana. E la sera il suo rituale resta lo stesso.
La sua è una storia, non una promessa: ognuno ha il suo percorso. Ma è il motivo per cui ho creato Piantasia. Godersi il gesto, lasciando andare la nicotina.
Dove posso comprare Piantasia?
Su
piantasia.eu
. Spediamo da Berlino in Italia e nel resto d'Europa.

Piantasia è una miscela di erbe senza tabacco e senza nicotina. Come tutti i nostri blend, è fatto a mano a Berlino, in piccoli lotti: le erbe vengono pulite dai rametti, macinate delicatamente e mescolate fino a una consistenza morbida. Ore di lavoro per ogni lotto, perché un rituale lento merita di essere preparato lentamente.
